title: Kestrel Fly & Drive Concierge Rules: Travel Reimbursement on Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
Under Delivery & Pickup Appointments, buyers who collect their vehicle through Kestrel Fly & Drive are reimbursed for their travel to the hub, subject to the rules below.

## What is reimbursed

| Travel cost | Reimbursed up to | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| One-way airfare to the hub | The method's airfare cap | none beyond the rules below |
| Rideshare or taxi from the arrival airport to the hub | The method's rideshare cap | none beyond the rules below |
| One hotel night | The method's hotel cap | The flight landed after 18:00 local time |

## Rules

**T1. Completed pickup.** Travel is reimbursed only after the pickup is completed. The status is read from the system record of the Fly & Drive appointment, and it must show completed.

**T2. No reimbursement without a handover.** A refused or cancelled pickup earns no reimbursement.

**T3. Receipt deadline.** Receipts must be submitted within the method's travel receipt submission days after the completed pickup date.

**T4. One reimbursement per receipt.** Each receipt is reimbursed once.

**T5. Cap per type, per appointment.** For each reimbursement type (airfare, rideshare and hotel), the total reimbursed on the appointment may not exceed that type's cap. The total is the sum of every reimbursement of that type already made on the appointment, plus the one being made.

**T6. Payment.** Payment is made within the method's travel reimbursement business days.

## Worked receipts (hypothetical caps: airfare $400.00, rideshare $60.00, hotel $120.00)

| Receipt | Already reimbursed of that type on the appointment | Room left under the cap | Reimbursed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Airfare $340.00 | $0.00 | $400.00 | $340.00 |
| Rideshare $72.00 | $0.00 | $60.00 | $60.00 |
| Hotel $95.00, flight landed at 21:15 local time | $0.00 | $120.00 | $95.00 |
| A second rideshare receipt, $25.00 | $60.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |

The second rideshare receipt adds nothing, because rideshare reimbursements on the appointment have already reached the $60.00 cap.

## Basis questions

**The buyer sends receipts while the appointment still shows dispatched.** Nothing is reimbursed yet. Reimbursement waits for the pickup to be completed.

**The buyer flew in but refused the vehicle at the hub.** No travel is reimbursed. A refused pickup earns no reimbursement.

**The same airfare receipt is submitted twice.** It is reimbursed once.
